crossRefs.note: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.
The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.
Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.
Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.
They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into the middle of it…
He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. Yahweh, our God, will cut…
The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.
He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.

translations.web: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.
translations.bsb: The nations have fallen into a pit of their making; their feet are caught in the net they have hidden.
translations.kjv: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
translations.asv: The nations are sunk down in the pit that they made: In the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
